nodes.title: Knowledge atlas
nodes.body: A synthetic extensible knowledge library. All examples are illustrative, not company findings.

nodes.title: Robotics
nodes.body: Study how robots perceive, learn, plan, and act. Explore World Action Models, learning and autonomy, and robot planning in this demonstration.

nodes.title: Artificial intelligence
nodes.body: Methods for learning from observations and building predictive models. World Action Models are shared with Robotics rather than duplicated.

nodes.title: Physics
nodes.body: Models of motion and physical interactions, with explicit assumptions and units. Start with Dynamics to inspect a toy motion model.

nodes.title: Mathematics
nodes.body: Foundations including optimization, algebra, and new areas you add later. Mathematical notes can stand alone or connect to applications.

nodes.title: Learning & autonomy
nodes.body: Research questions about learning action choices and predictive models for autonomous robots. World Action Models is one subtopic.

nodes.title: Robot planning
nodes.body: Choosing robot trajectories and actions subject to constraints. Related investigations can connect to optimization and dynamics.

nodes.title: Unclassified
nodes.body: New work can remain here until an appropriate topic is proposed.
